macros.name: enableTiling
macros.doc: When you execute \enableTiling, the graphic tile currently defined will be used.

macros.name: placeTilesinLayers
macros.doc: To get the tiles to appear in their a layer (all in the same layer), use the aeb_tilebg \placeTilesinLayers command.
